hook_lines: Found this Starbucks drink at Japan's Don Quijote
Korea doesn't sell this flavor at all

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Released only around February 15th each year, alongside Starbucks' Spring Blend beans
Starbucks reworked the sakura-strawberry scent blend in 2023 after complaints it was unbalanced
Korea's official Starbucks At Home lineup has matcha latte but never this flavor — everything sold in Korea is a personal import
Average review rating is 3.92 out of 5 — 71% gave 4 or 5 stars, but 19% gave just 1 or 2
Zero real fruit juice — the sakura and strawberry taste is entirely from flavoring

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 사쿠라 스트로베리 라테를 물에 타서 마시는 리액션 영상. 스틱을 뜯어서 붓는 장면, 완성된 분홍빛 라떼를 한 모금 마시고 반응하는 표정 위주 클로즈업이 있으면 더 좋음. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 星巴克 樱花草莓拿铁 日本限定 试喝

quotes.japanese: 思っていたより桜の香りが強すぎて、私は具合がわるくなりました
quotes.translation: The sakura scent was way stronger than I expected, and it actually made me feel sick.

quotes.japanese: 春らしいイメージにつられて買ってみましたが、なんとも言えない香りが好みではありませんでした。濃すぎるのでお湯を多めに入れてやっと飲める感じです。
quotes.translation: I bought it because the spring packaging looked so appealing, but the smell wasn't really my thing — hard to describe. It's so concentrated I had to add extra hot water just to make it drinkable.

quotes.japanese: この時期になると飲みたくなる。桜は感じないけど、ストロベリーとコーヒーのほろ苦さが美味しい
quotes.translation: I crave this every year around this time. I don't really taste the sakura, but the strawberry and the coffee's bitter edge together are delicious.

quotes.japanese: 海外の友人へのお土産用に購入。人気らしく、棚の目立つところにたくさん置いてあった。
quotes.translation: Bought it as a souvenir for a friend overseas. It looked popular — there was a big stack right at eye level on the shelf.

quotes.japanese: また買いたいのに、もう店頭にないですね。
quotes.translation: I want to buy it again, but it's already gone from stores.
